dreamteamer.title: Contacts
dreamteamer.description: People you deal with — `contacts`, each pointing at the `companies` record they work for, with an avatar from `assets`. The `scraping-contacts` skill and `/scrape-contact` fill a person in from LinkedIn, one batched container per run, and from web search. With `meetings` installed, each contact also carries the latest meeting they attended.
